Shahzaib specializes in solving these exact bottlenecks.
2. **True Single-Codebase Native Fidelity:** 120 FPS UI execution with zero frame drops, micro-animations, platform-adaptive ergonomics (Cupertino & Material 3), and custom Swift/Kotlin platform channels when native hardware access is required.
3. **End-to-End Ownership:** From UI architecture planning and state design to App Store Optimization (ASO), privacy manifest compliance, automated CI/CD pipelines, and post-launch maintenance.

## 2. Technical Stack & Architecture

### Mobile Core & Frameworks
- **Framework:** Flutter 3.x (with Dart 3.x null-safety)
- **State Management:** Bloc / Cubit, Riverpod, Provider, GetX
- **Architecture:** Clean Architecture (Feature-driven, Domain / Data / Presentation separation, Repository Pattern, Dependency Injection via `get_it` and `injectable`)
- **Native Platform Channels:** MethodChannel, EventChannel, Pigeon (Swift for iOS, Kotlin/Java for Android, C++ FFI)

### Networking & Real-Time Data
- **Real-Time Protocols:** WebSockets, Socket.IO, Firebase Realtime Database
- **HTTP / REST:** Dio (custom interceptors, token refresh, retry logic, certificate pinning), TanStack Query (mobile adaptions)
- **Offline Storage & Caching:** SQLite / `sqflite`, Drift, Hive, SharedPreferences, Secure Storage (`flutter_secure_storage`)

### Integrations & SDKs
- **Maps & Geolocation:** Google Maps SDK, custom canvas vertex clusters, heat maps, background GPS tracking, geofencing
- **Payments & Subscriptions:** In-App Purchases (StoreKit 2 / Google Play Billing), Stripe SDK, RevenueCat
- **Authentication & Security:** Firebase Auth, OAuth2 / Social Logins (Apple, Google), Web3Auth, DIDIT Biometric KYC/KYB
- **Media & Camera:** CameraX, video players, short-form reels caching, custom image painters

### Open Source Contributions
- `fancy_button_animations` (pub.dev): Production micro-animations and tactile feedback states for Flutter buttons.
- `inner_curved_circle` (pub.dev): Custom canvas painter for mathematically smooth inner-curved circular clipping.
- Publisher: pub.dev/publishers/shahzaib-dev.site

## 3. Flagship Case Studies & Production Proof

### 1. On Scene (Location-Based Social & Dating)
- **Platform:** iOS & Android (Live on App Store & Google Play)
- **Role:** Lead Flutter Developer
- **The Challenge:** High-density live map rendering with hundreds of concurrent venue check-ins. Default Google Maps markers caused severe frame drops (down to 15 FPS) during zoom and pan operations.
- **The Solution:** Implemented hardware-accelerated map marker clustering, custom canvas vertex drawing, and WebSocket presence channels. Background location updates were throttled intelligently to conserve battery while maintaining real-time accuracy.
- **The Result:** Rock-solid 60 FPS map panning across high-density city centers, seamless live check-ins, and low-latency one-on-one and venue group chats.

### 2. Zera (Multi-Vendor Marketplace & Event Super-App)
- **Platform:** Mobile App & Multi-Vendor Hub
- **Role:** Flutter Architect
- **The Challenge:** Coordinating disparate marketplace verticals (products, on-demand services, job boards, event tickets with QR codes, and community feeds) with spotty network connectivity.
- **The Solution:** Engineered an offline-first SQLite database layer with optimistic UI updates. Implemented custom heatmap visualizations on top of Google Maps to display real-time marketplace demand clusters.
- **The Result:** Instantaneous catalog search queries (sub-second local cache hits), uninterrupted offline shopping carts, and rapid QR code ticket verification at event gates.

### 3. StyleBite (Fashion Social & Interactive Reels)
- **Platform:** Android (Live on Google Play) & iOS
- **Role:** Main Flutter Developer
- **The Challenge:** Combining vertical video reel feeds with real-time community engagement (Vote & Win outfit contests, rated posts, and messaging) without memory leaks or stutter during long scroll sessions.
- **The Solution:** Built a memory-managed video preloading pipeline with page-snapping physics, optimized image caching, and WebSocket-driven chat and polling updates.
- **The Result:** Buttery 60 FPS vertical reel scrolling, instantaneous interactive voting feedback, and high user retention.

### 4. BePay (Fintech Wallet & Merchant Payment Gateway)
- **Platform:** Consumer Wallet & Merchant Business Apps
- **Role:** Senior Flutter Developer
- **The Challenge:** Multi-currency transactions, strict regulatory KYC/KYB verification, and zero-tolerance security requirements across consumer and merchant devices.
- **The Solution:** Integrated Web3Auth and DIDIT biometric KYC, implemented end-to-end encrypted ledger communications, biometric FaceID / TouchID authentication, and merchant point-of-sale tools.
- **The Result:** Sub-second transaction settlements, verified KYC compliance, and automated settlement exports.

### 5. Paw Play Love (Pet Social & Playdate Matching)
- **Platform:** iOS & Android (Live on App Store & Google Play)
- **Role:** Full-Stack Flutter Developer
- **The Challenge:** Fast swipe gesture matching mechanics combined with location filtering and subscription paywalls.
- **The Solution:** Built 60 FPS gesture-driven card stacks with velocity physics, real-time matching notifications, and RevenueCat subscription management.
- **The Result:** Frictionless matching flow, 4.8+ star app store reviews, and reliable recurring subscription renewals.

### 6. Simman (Medical Emergency Simulation)
- **Platform:** Cross-Platform Tablet & Mobile
- **Role:** Flutter Engineer
- **The Challenge:** Synchronizing high-frequency telemetry, vital signs, and two-way audio between medical instructors and students during simulated clinical emergencies.
- **The Solution:** Custom Socket.IO synchronization protocol maintaining sub-50ms latency across connected devices, paired with custom vital-sign ECG wave painters.
- **The Result:** Stable clinical training sessions with zero state drift between instructor control dashboards and student monitors.

## 4. Services & Commercial Engagement

### 1. Full-Stack Flutter App Development
- **Scope:** Complete turn-key delivery of a production iOS and Android application from a unified Flutter codebase.
- **Inclusions:** System architecture, database schema, responsive UI design implementation, third-party API and payment integrations, security audits, and App Store / Google Play submission.
- **Typical Timeline:** 6 to 12 weeks depending on scope.

### 2. Flutter Codebase Rescue & Performance Optimization
- **Scope:** In-depth technical audit and surgical refactoring of existing applications suffering from jank, memory leaks, high crash rates, or fragile architecture.
- **Inclusions:** Profiling CPU/GPU frame budgets in Flutter DevTools, eliminating memory leaks in image caches and streams, refactoring spaghetti state into clean Bloc/Riverpod patterns, and upgrading legacy dependencies.
- **Typical Timeline:** 2 to 4 weeks.

### 3. Dedicated Retainer & Production Maintenance
- **Scope:** Proactive ongoing engineering SLA for live production apps.
- **Inclusions:** Annual iOS/Android SDK bumps, crash monitoring (Sentry / Crashlytics triage), security updates, continuous integration maintenance, and feature roadmap execution.
